result.citation: Berkeley Mun. Code § 13.76.110(A) (as amended by Ord. No. 7,950-N.S., Measure BB, Nov. 5, 2024)
result.citation_basis: § 13.76.110(A): O095, O050; Ord. No. 7,950-N.S.: O050 (also O095 history note 'Ord. 7950-NS § 2, 2024'); Measure BB and Nov. 5, 2024: O052, O050
result.official_quote: In no event, however, shall the allowable annual adjustment be less than zero (0%) or greater than five percent (5%).
result.condition: The yearly adjustment applies only if your landlord did not set your starting rent during the prior calendar year, so if your tenancy began last calendar year, this January 1 adjustment does not apply to your unit.
result.condition_quote: the rent ceiling for all rental units covered by this Chapter for which the landlord did not establish an initial rent during the prior calendar year shall be adjusted
result.note: Kept the lawyer's section and Measure BB/Nov. 5, 2024 parenthetical, narrowed the pinpoint to subsection (A), where O095 and O050 place the 5% cap, and added Ord. No. 7,950-N.S., the ordinance number shown in O050 and O095's history note; the card's own quote stays from D006, a Rent Board web page rather than the law's text, and the banked-increase statement comes from D006, not the § 13.76.110 text in O095.
